breakdown.description: The prompt sets the free-end rotation to zero, even though a cantilever’s free end is generally free to rotate under an end point load.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not set the free-end rotation to zero. The only boundary conditions stated are y(0) = 0 and dy/dx(0) = 0 at the fixed end (x=0), which are the correct cantilever boundary conditions. The erroneous instruction to set free-end rotation to zero was not repeated.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'The moment distribution is constant at M = PL over the full span,' directly repeating the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this entirely, as the correct bending moment for a cantilever with an end point load varies linearly from 0 at the free end to PL at the fixed end. This inconsistency was not resolved.
